$comment: labels.json (shopify-app-kit): the label set every consumer repo carries. `labels` is the list scripts/sync-labels.mjs creates or updates (never deletes); `ladder` is the executor order the issue-filing skill and the routines read (least privileged first; human:bootstrap sits beside human:account). Every issue carries exactly one work-type label (code only, agent:*, human:*), one priority (p1..p3) and one ROI bucket (roi:5..roi:1); the rest are gating and origin labels. Colors: the three agent rungs are a blue ramp, the four human rungs an amber-to-red ramp.

labels.name: code only
labels.description: Work type: a PR (code, config, docs, tests) fully closes it

labels.name: agent:ci
labels.description: Work type: closed by adding, editing or dispatching an Actions workflow with the repo's own secrets

labels.name: agent:cloud
labels.description: Work type: needs to reach the store itself, but no login and no maintainer-only file

labels.name: agent:local
labels.description: Work type: a Claude Code CLI session on the maintainer's machine (logged-in CLIs, .env, a browser)

labels.name: human:bootstrap
labels.description: Work type: a one-time maintainer action; the issues under Unlocks become agent work when it closes

labels.name: human:decision
labels.description: Work type: a product, architecture or art-direction choice, answered by a comment starting decision:

labels.name: human:account
labels.description: Work type: account, identity, payment, payout, tax, 2FA or dashboard-only work with no API

labels.name: human:legal
labels.description: Work type: legal, compliance, trademark, DPA or third-party review

labels.name: p1
labels.description: Priority: unblocked work that gates a real install or protects money or data

labels.name: p2
labels.description: Priority: unblocked, planned

labels.name: p3
labels.description: Priority: deploy, blocked, or nice-to-have

labels.name: roi:5
labels.description: ROI bucket 5 of 5: highest value per unit of effort

labels.name: roi:4
labels.description: ROI bucket 4 of 5

labels.name: roi:3
labels.description: ROI bucket 3 of 5

labels.name: roi:2
labels.description: ROI bucket 2 of 5

labels.name: roi:1
labels.description: ROI bucket 1 of 5: lowest value per unit of effort

labels.name: launch-gate
labels.description: Gating: must close before the first real install

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Gating: waiting on another issue; the body says which one ("after #N")

labels.name: deploy
labels.description: Gating: registration or deployment work

labels.name: qa
labels.description: Origin: opened by a scheduled QA workflow on failure

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Origin: dependency advisories and deliberate major upgrades

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something is broken

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Documentation only
